env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOOS=linux
env GOARCH=386
env GO386=invalid

cd m
# Upstream exposes the raw setting through go env and lets the compiler
# report an invalid GO386 during a build. Driver initialization must not panic.
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1274/bin/go env GO386
stdout '^invalid$'
go env GO386
stdout '^invalid$'
! go build .
stderr 'unsupported setting GO386=invalid'
! stderr 'panic:'
env GO386=sse2
go env GO386
stdout '^sse2$'
env GO386=softfloat
go env GO386
stdout '^softfloat$'

# Keep existing diagnostics and raw-env behavior of the other settings.
env GOARCH=arm64
env GOARM64=invalid
! go env GOARM64
stderr 'invalid GOARM64'
! stderr 'panic:'
env GOARM64=v8.0
env GOARCH=amd64
env GOAMD64=invalid
go env GOAMD64
stdout '^invalid$'
env GOAMD64=v1
env GOARCH=arm
env GOARM=invalid
go env GOARM
stdout '^invalid$'

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/envcompat

go 1.27

-- m/value.go --
package envcompat

func Value() int { return 42 }
